copy.zh: 看起来是照着别人的作品做的，或用了不是自己的素材。市场只收原创（或注明来源的 CC0 / 公有领域素材）。
copy.en: This looks copied from someone else's work or uses assets you don't own. The gallery only accepts original work (or credited CC0 / public-domain assets).

brand.zh: 用了真实品牌、机构或名人的名字、标志。改成虚构的品牌再交。
brand.en: Uses a real brand, organization or person. Please switch to a made-up brand and resubmit.

phish.zh: 像在仿冒真实网站的登录或付款页面。市场不收这类设计。
phish.en: Looks like an imitation of a real login or payment page. The gallery does not accept these.

personal.zh: 里面有像真人的手机号、身份证号、邮箱、地址或照片。换成明显的假数据再交。
personal.en: Contains what looks like real personal data (phone, ID, email, address, photo). Replace it with obvious fake data.

qr.zh: 有二维码。换成一个占位方块再交（二维码可能指向任何地方）。
qr.en: Contains a QR code. Replace it with a placeholder square (a QR code could point anywhere).

quality.zh: 还不太完整（空白屏、明显排版问题，或和已有的太像）。打磨一下再交。
quality.en: Not quite finished yet (blank screens, obvious layout problems, or too close to an existing design). Please polish and resubmit.

nsfw.en: The content is not suitable for the gallery.

politics.zh: 涉及政治、宗教或其他敏感话题。市场只收中性的设计。
politics.en: Touches on political, religious or other sensitive topics. The gallery only takes neutral designs.

inject.zh: 文字里有像在给模型下指令的内容。删掉或改写再交。
inject.en: Contains text that reads like instructions to an AI model. Remove or rephrase it.

author.zh: 等你回复。14 天没有回应会自动关闭，之后随时可以重新提交。
author.en: Waiting for your reply. This will close automatically after 14 days without a response; you can resubmit any time.

other.zh: 维护者会在下面说明原因。
